name: Iguana
blurb: Iguana Bits — a legacy raw meat with no creature source in Appalachia. Found in raw-meat loot and sold by meat vendors.
editorial_note: There is no iguana creature in Fallout 76 — Iguana Bits is a legacy loot / vendor meat. It is sourced from the raw-meat loot pools (Container_Loot_Meat_Basic, LL_Food_Any_Basic, LL_Food_Meat_Raw, LL_Meat_IguanaMeat); meat vendors (LLV_Vendor_Food_Whitespring_Meat_Raw_Basic); the ATX_Resources_RadTurkeyFieldDressingStation_resource, ATX_Resources_WallmountedOven_resource resource station. It has no world creature spawns.
